name: YARA Skeleton Builder
summary: Turns selected suspicious strings into a reviewable defensive YARA rule draft.

manifest.json.name: YARA Skeleton Builder
manifest.json.author: local
manifest.json.description: Turns selected suspicious strings into a reviewable defensive YARA rule draft.

config.script:
import base64, re, hashlib
text = base64.b64decode("{{selection.text.b64}}").decode("utf-8", "replace")
tokens = []
for token in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9_./:@-]{4,80}", text):
    if token.lower() in {"http", "https", "user", "password", "token"}:
        continue
    tokens.append(token)
unique = []
for token in tokens:
    if token not in unique:
        unique.append(token)
unique = unique[:12]
rule_id = hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()[:10]
print("YARA SKELETON BUILDER")
if not unique:
    print("No useful strings detected in selected text.")
    raise SystemExit
print(f"rule qp1ng_triage_{rule_id} {{")
print("    meta:")
print("        author = \"Q-P1NG Action Forge\"")
print("        purpose = \"defensive triage draft\"")
print("    strings:")
for idx, token in enumerate(unique, 1):
    escaped = token.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"")
    print(f"        ${idx} = \"{escaped}\" ascii wide")
print("    condition:")
print("        2 of them")
print("}")
print()
print("Review strings and scope before using this rule in a lab.")
